name: Diana el Circled
original_name: ディアーナ・エル・サークリッド
source:
Star Sign: Cancer

The second princess of the Klein Kingdom.
Because she is the youngest child and doted upon by the crown prince [url=/c45875]Seirios[/url] she was raised pretty freely for royalty.
She has a calm personality but she acts sort of tomboyish.
She made a promise to a boy with blue eyes when she was younger, she hasn't forgotten it and even now wishes to meet him again.
